Smoothie Ice Cream, 3 super delicious, healthy flavours made without any refined sugar, using just frozen fruits and no ice! They have that incredible soft-serve ice cream texture, making them perfect for when you’re craving something sweet and creamy.
All three flavours come together in just 5 minutes once your fruits are frozen, and the results are absolutely incredible. Do give these a try! The full written recipes are mentioned below in the description. Happy Blending!
Say hello to the BLP 2.0, your new kitchen superstar that makes cooking easier, faster, and way more fun!
